name: Kashvi Arora
headline: Personal Brand Strategist | 1M+ Impressions | Tech × Creativity | Public Speaker | Event Curator (300+) | Judge Panel (50+) | National-Level Awardee, MUNs & Hackathon

sections.bio:
Hey!

I’m Kashvi Arora, a builder at heart who loves creating things that blend tech, strategy, and storytelling.

I’ve worked on multiple SaaS projects, diving deep into product, management, and marketing, and helping brands grow through data-driven and creative strategies. In freelancing, I have worked as a personal brand strategist and a growth advocate who loves helping people discover their voice and amplify their impact.

Over time, I’ve collaborated with 30+ startups, mentored 200K+ students, and curated more than 200+ technical, leadership, and community events across India.

I've also been to various judging panels - MUNs, Debates, Ideathons, Hackathons, and speaking at various institutions, multiple tech conferences and infact at Microsoft, I’ve learned that growth happens when you say yes to opportunities that scare and excite you at the same time.

When I’m not working on a project, you’ll probably find me on stage, creating content, working with a camera or speaking at a podcast. Theatre, storytelling, and building communities is all what I LOVE. 

My journey has been a mix of building products, leading people, and telling stories  and I’m grateful it’s taken me from global internships to impactful speaker sessions, and to winning national-level awards for innovation and leadership.

For brand campaigns -
Write to me at [email protected] 

We'll be speaking soon!

posts.text:
I’m HIRING an Assistant Project Manager Intern! 

If you’re organized, proactive, comfortable with ambiguity, and want hands-on experience building an AI education startup from scratch, this is for you.

📍 Location: Gurgaon (Work from Office)
🎓 Internship Opportunity
      Stipend based 

COMMENT “LINK” 👇

and I’ll send you the application form.

Hackathon Mentor at Girls Hack Day 2026 at Paytm Office! 💙 

A room full of women building, debugging, brainstorming, and refusing to stop at "good enough." 

Genuinely one of those days I'll remember, Organised by Commudle Developer Network & Commudle, and the energy in that room said everything about why spaces like this matter! 

With more than 500+ Girls and the team I mentored WON 🏆 Congratulations Laxmi singh, Aayushi Johri, Geetika Agrawal, so proud of what you built.

Also got to meet some incredible girls there, Harshita Dargan, Sunaina Chhabra, Ishita Gupta, Ishika Vashisht, loved every conversation.

Huge thanks to Arpan Garg and the entire team Alok Kumar, Vidhi Bhawra, Sakshi Tomar, Vaishnavi Mishra, SNEHA SINGH, Ritik Gupta, Jatin Garg for having me and building a space where women can learn, build, compete, and actually believe in the impact they can create. That last part is the hardest one to teach, and they're doing it anyway.

Grateful too for the mentors and judges I got to share the day with Maya Sherman, Surabhi Sharma (She/Her), Priyanshi R., Rajashree Nedungadi, TUSHIKA RAWAT, Ekta Arora, Prerna Rawal, Kratika Jain, Shiti Sharma, Smriti Singh, Bhumika Narula ❤️

And the amazing partners GitHub, MLH Fellowship, Major League Hacking, Google for Developers, Plaksha University, Endless Domains, SheKunj.com 

Being around women this passionate about tech and about the next generation of builders is exactly the kind of full I like being.

Days like this remind me why I keep showing up to build it. 🚀

#WomenInTech

Attended the Cursor India Roadshow:
Delhi Buildathon and it was CRAZYYY! 🚀

200+ builders, one venue, one energy: BUILD.

On 26th July, I had a chance to meet and build at a buildathon organised by Cursor Community at STAGE headquarters in Delhi. 

With that amazing sessions by Hardik Sodhani who opened with Cursor 101, MCP, and skills. Followed by Jason Wiker talking cloud AI agents and why they’re the future of software teams.

While I was shipping Dev Bureau, an AI product that turns your social profile data into a personality-driven portfolio along with Saral Jain 👩🏻‍💻

That's the real flex of this ecosystem right now. You don't just learn about AI dev tools anymore, you sit in a room full of builders and ship something before the day ends! 

Huge thanks to Ben Lang, Hadi Khan, Anuja Nimbalkar, Shaurya Gulati and the whole Cursor team for bringing this to India. ❤️

Also got the chance to interact with the most amazing Kunal Kumrawat sir, founding member of STAGE. The kind of conversation that stays with you way after the event ends.

Connected with some amazing builders; Chhavi Garg, Harshit Khemani, Nikunj Rustagi, Aaqa Ishtyaq, Palak Purwar, Harsh Agarwal 

Already counting down to the next one. Build first, talk later! 

#WomenInTech

An Education Minister resigned just because GenZ refused to back down! 

1000s of youngsters sat at Jantar Mantar and said enough…

That's what happens when youth stop competing with each other and start standing with each other.

And it is the exact muscle we need right now,
Not just for exam papers. For everything.

Because while we're still arguing over reservation seats, category cutoffs, who deserves what, the world outside has moved on to a different question entirely

AI is rewriting what "qualified" even means. It doesn't care about your category, your college tier, your backup plan. 

It cares if you can build, adapt, ship.

We're fighting 1990s battles in a 2026 economy

Dharmendra Pradhan resigning is proof that youth unity works. 

Imagine what we could do if that same unity went into building instead of protesting. Into learning instead of blaming. Into showing up for each other instead of gatekeeping opportunity.

Nobody is coming to hand us the future,
Not the government, 
not the reservation list, 
not a resignation letter.

We build it. Together. Or not at all.

🇮🇳

Narendra Modi, Cockroach Janata Party, The Hindu

Community is the cheat code nobody talks about!

And recently, it showed me exactly what I've been building towards...

🎤 Got to speak at VIBEVERSE 2026 organized by Builder Base x MetaMask × DevSphereIndia at Unstop, Saket on Personal Branding with Al for Builders. Watching builders in that room have that lightbulb moment was something else entirely.

Alongside some amazing speakers Sudhansu Kumar Jha, Surya Gupta, Arshia Mathur, Anshul Kanswal and Dev Pratap Singh ㅤ  
Thanks Nisha kumari inviting!

🚀Hackathon Judge at Buildathon 2026 by Unison Community with 1,253 participants and 450+ submissions. Students who are not waiting for the right time or the right opportunity. They're just building.

Alonside some amazing co-judges Bhavika ., SARTHAK SEMWAL, and Amit Kumar Prasad
Thanks to Salman Rahi and Siddika Fatma Khan for inviting!

Being a woman in tech means I know exactly how rare it felt to find rooms where I belonged.

So every time I get to be in one, speaking, judging, mentoring, I take it seriously 🏆

#PersonalBranding #AlForBuilders #WomenInTech #Community #BuildInPublic #Delhi
